description: A developer workbench for DSH: a GPU-accelerated terminal (restty renderer, Rust PTY) and a sandboxed browser. Registers Terminal + Browser tabs in dsh-better-sidebar when present, with a standalone floating-panel fallback. Exposes a restty-native wire-protocol WebSocket at /powerdesk/ws/terminal and a browser embeddability probe at /powerdesk/api/browser.probe.
